SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, p.author, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.topic, ''), 'discussion') AS topic, p.title, p.content, p.views, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.user_id) AS likeCount, CASE WHEN #{currentUserId} IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN pl.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS likedByCurrentUser, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS commentCount, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(p.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM community_post p LEFT JOIN community_post_like pl ON pl.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN community_comment c ON c.post_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{id} GROUP BY p.id, p.user_id, p.author, p.topic, p.title, p.content, p.views, p.created_at, p.updated_at

mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.author, c.content, COUNT(l.user_id) AS likeCount, CASE WHEN #{currentUserId} IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN l.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS likedByCurrentUser, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM community_comment c LEFT JOIN community_comment_like l ON l.comment_id = c.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} GROUP BY c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.author, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) ASC, CASE WHEN c.parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, c.id ASC
